# AgentGuard

AgentGuard is a zero-trust control plane for autonomous financial agents.

## Core behavior
- Treat AI-generated payment intent as untrusted input.
- Issue short-lived HMAC-SHA256 signed capabilities.
- Enforce user-configured daily and per-transaction spending limits server-side.
- Enforce merchant, category, action, expiry, velocity and replay controls.
- Use atomic SQLite transactions for final budget reservation and payment insertion.
- Record decisions and payments in a tamper-evident audit hash chain.
- Provide an Attack Lab and security benchmark for adversarial demonstrations.

## Demo
The local dashboard uses simulated payments only. No real financial transaction is performed.
